about.text2: We discuss your application, documentation requirements and supply terms. Certifications, including ISO and Halal, are verified for the specific manufacturer and product on request.

about.value1Text: We consider your product's purpose, desired scent and technical constraints.
about.value2Text: A sample helps you assess compatibility before committing to supply.
about.value3Text: Documentation, origin, volumes and lead times are agreed for each product.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: By submitting a request, you allow the Fragrances & Co team to process your information to respond to your enquiry and discuss supply.
privacy.data: Your name, phone or email, selected product, company name and comments if provided. We also record the time of your request and consent.
privacy.use: Requests are stored in the website database and may be forwarded to responsible staff via the Telegram Bot API. Your data is not used for marketing without separate consent.
privacy.rights: You can request access, correction or deletion through the contact form. Include the contact details used in your original request.
privacy.retention: Information is retained until the enquiry is resolved or consent is withdrawn, unless applicable law requires otherwise.
